desc_en: These sneakers combine contemporary design with superior functionality. The breathable mesh upper offers optimal ventilation and a precise fit. The MD sole and removable EVA insole provide continuous support and traction. Their versatile aesthetic adapts naturally to any season. Each pair is crafted on demand to preserve the exclusivity of the house.

Cada par se confecciona bajo demanda para preservar la exclusividad de la casa.
